study: Clopper-Pearson interval coverage under the production LHS design
question: Does the two-sided 95 per cent Clopper-Pearson interval attain its nominal coverage when the sample is the production randomized-LHS design at N = 1e5, whose rows are dependent?

decision_rule.registered: before the first replicate was drawn (S05 pre-edit verdicts)
decision_rule.apparatus_gate: the iid control's one-sided 95 per cent lower confidence limit on coverage is at least 0.9 at every cell, or the study is void
decision_rule.verdict: coverage is not contradicted at a cell when the same lower limit is at least 0.9

paired_bootstrap_secondary.note: secondary measurement, added after the decision rule was fixed; the same rule is applied to it but the primary verdict above is on the Clopper-Pearson cells only
